claims: Previous Haiku scored 0% on agentic coding (Terminal-Bench 2.0); Haiku 5.5 scores 39% (max effort) and costs ~90% less
Computer use (OSWorld): 15.7% -> 72.4%; visual reasoning 6% -> 46%; knowledge work (GDPval) roughly doubled (735 -> 1620 on screen)
Price $0.10 input / $0.50 output per million tokens vs old $1 / $5; above 100k tokens price jumps ~5x ($0.50 / $2.50 on screen)
HubSpot: 92.8% on its CRM eval suite, best ever; Asana: >30% lower latency; AlphaSense: ~8M calls/week, statistically significant improvement
Anthropic says Sonnet and Opus remain better for complex agentic coding; 39% is max-effort, around 20% at medium effort
how_to_steps: Treat Haiku 5.5 as the default for classification, summarizing, routing and now light agentic/computer-use tasks
Keep Sonnet/Opus for complex multi-step coding
Watch context length: keep Haiku calls under 100k tokens to stay at the cheap tier
